documents.title: Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences reported a 16% year-on-year revenue growth for Q2 FY27, driven by new product launches and strong demand in its non-GPL and CDMO businesses. Management reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% and expects EBITDA margins to remain in the 35% to 36% range. The company is expanding its manufacturing footprint with the Solapur facility and an R&D center in Taloja, while maintaining a net debt-free balance sheet. Management also highlighted a strategic focus on scaling the CDMO business and developing a portfolio of high-potency APIs and oral solid formulations. Alivus Life reported revenue growth of 16.0% YoY to ₹6,820 million in Q2 FY27, driven by strong demand across key markets and contributions from recent launches.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
guidance.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: The company is confident in delivering EBITDA margins between 35% and 36% for FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expressed confidence in sustaining growth momentum through ongoing capacity expansion and a healthy development pipeline.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, our ongoing capacity expansion and healthy development pipeline give us confidence in sustaining this momentum and delivering consistent growth.

guidance.claim: Management guided for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to remain in the 30% to 32% range.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

guidance.claim: Growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY27.
guidance.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year, resulting in a stronger H2 performance.

guidance.claim: R&D expenditure is projected to end up at a steady state of around 4%.
guidance.quote: So we should sort of end up at a steady state of around 4%.

demand_outlook.claim: The company reports healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets for its generic API business.
demand_outlook.quote: Our generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management describes the current pricing environment as stable.
demand_outlook.quote: So the pricing environment, I would say, is quite stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 16.0% YoY due to healthy demand across key markets and strong contributions from recent launches.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: Non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL business declined by 52.6% year-on-year due to inventory rationalization.
demand_outlook.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization. And so if you recall, Q4 was pretty strong, and we saw a dip in Q1, a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: The CDMO segment is expected to gain momentum in the second half of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we can expect the segment to gain momentum in the second half of the year, supported by contributions from newly added projects.

demand_outlook.claim: Geographically, broad-based growth was observed across all markets during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Geographically, we saw broad-based growth across all markets during the quarter, highlighting the strength of the diversified business.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the R&D center at Taloja is progressing and expected to be on schedule early next year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our R&D center at Taloja is also progressing well, and we hope to be on schedule early next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new R&D facility in Taloja is advancing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The construction of new R&D facility at Taloja (Navi Mumbai) is advancing as planned

capex_expansion.claim: Solapur is progressing as planned and will be operational in early Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction at the Taloja R&D center has begun and will proceed on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to incur a capex of approximately INR 540 crores in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Dahej is expanding with 160KL and Ankleshwar with 110KL.
capex_expansion.quote: So Dahej is getting 160KL and Ankleshwar is getting like 110KL.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to remain between 30% and 32% as a floor if market conditions are unfavorable.
margins_costs.quote: But as a floor, right, as a floor, let's say, nothing works out. We'll still be between the 30% to 32% range.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by 670 bps YoY to 64.4% in Q2 FY27 due to a favorable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins improved to 60.2%, up 510 basis points year-on-year due to a favorable product mix, newer launches, and operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins increased by 650 basis points year-on-year to 36.6% supported by enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have increased, and the company has managed to pass on a part of it to customers.
margins_costs.quote: So there has been an increase in raw material prices. It's not been very steep and we have managed to pass on a part of it to our customers.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a pipeline of over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally.
orders_capacity.quote: Our pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The high potent API portfolio includes 30 new products in the active grid.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high potent API portfolio continues to advance with 30 new products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Return on invested capital expanded to ~34%, highlighting asset productivity.
orders_capacity.quote: ROICE expanded to ~34% – underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.

orders_capacity.claim: Global DMF and CEP filings stood at 617 as of June 30.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

orders_capacity.claim: The high-potent API portfolio has 29 products in the active grid representing a $82 billion addressable market.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the high-potent API portfolio, 13 products have been validated, 7 are in advanced stages, and 9 are in lab development.
orders_capacity.quote: Of these 13 products have been validated, 7 are in advanced stages of development and the remaining 9 products are progressing through lab development stages.

orders_capacity.claim: CDMO revenue currently comes from 5 projects while active discussions are underway for about 7 projects.
orders_capacity.quote: One second, I talked about 7 new inquiries that we are working on. The current revenue is coming out of 5 projects, okay?

capital_allocation.claim: The company remains net debt-free with significant cash and cash equivalents.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a net debt-free company, and we have generated a strong free cash flow of INR270 crores leading to cash and cash equivalents, including short-term investments of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Capex for the quarter stood at INR 85 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow moment, our capex for the quarter stood at INR85 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated a free cash flow of INR 90 crores in the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores, leading to cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments of INR880 crores as of 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to remain a debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified potential volatility in solvent prices due to crude oil fluctuations as a key headwind.
risks_headwinds.quote: But you never know. I mean, if crude, let's say, touches $200 a barrel, I mean, solvent prices accordingly would get impacted. And that is probably the only headwind that we see based on our experience of these last 8-9 months, right, that could come and get us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains watchful of the evolving geopolitical and demand environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: So while we remain watchful of the evolving geopolitical and demand environment, the strength of our business fundamentals gives us confidence in our growth outlook.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing war situation has made management cautious regarding raw material prices and margin guidance.
risks_headwinds.quote: The issue is this war situation, and what it's doing to raw material prices. So we need to be a little bit cautious.

risks_headwinds.claim: Solapur experienced a slight delay in construction progress.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to double the CDMO business in the next 3 to 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: Except the fact that on CDMO, we have been guiding that we will double the business from where it is today in next 3 to 4 years' time

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to build an oral solids formulation facility within 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: Like I said, very likely that we'll take a call soon to build a formulation, oral solids facility, and we should get that done in about 18 to 24 months.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to add approximately 160 KL brownfield API capacity at Dahej by Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Brownfield API Dahej Planned addition of ~160KL Capacity Q3 FY27

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to complete Phase 1 greenfield expansion of ~340 KL capacity at Solapur in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 1 - ~340 KL (Intermediate block and Backward Integration) Q3 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Phase 2 greenfield expansion of ~125 KL capacity at Solapur is scheduled for completion in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 2 - ~125 KL (API / Pharma block) Q4 FY27

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to complete a brownfield addition of ~100 KL capacity at Ankleshwar by Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Management targets Solapur to be operational in early Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company guides for a revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.
management_commitments.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to incur a capex of approximately INR 540 crores in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
